name: Backend TypeScript
description: Orchestration profile for TypeScript/Node.js backend services with strict type checking and repository-native testing.

tools.name: node
tools.description: Node.js runtime for TypeScript services and test tooling.

tools.name: tsc
tools.description: TypeScript compiler for static type checking (can be invoked via the repository package runner).

candidate_checks.description: Run TypeScript static type checking without emitting build artifacts.
Run the unit test suite defined by the consumer repository.
Check source code conventions using the project linter configuration.

expected_evidence: Actual exit codes of the accepted typecheck and test commands
Scope verification of modified files and git diff --check output
Evidence triage report from Jev (jev-1.13.0) and evaluation from a fresh reviewer
special_risks: Using any or unsafe type assertions that bypass the TypeScript type system
Unhandled promise rejections or event loop blocking
Breaking API/DTO data contracts or using floating-point numbers for currency
quant_escalation_required_when: Computing PnL, funding rates, liquidation, margin, leverage, or portfolio risk
